strings.name: Satya Nadella
strings.role: Microsoft chairman and CEO · Cloud computing and AI
strings.summary: Nadella rose from engineering and enterprise software to Microsoft’s leadership. He advanced its cloud transition, brought LinkedIn and GitHub into the business during his tenure, and expanded cooperation with OpenAI. His influence lies primarily in technology platforms, developer ecosystems and corporate decisions rather than individual inventions.
strings.coverageNote: Sources checked through November 13, 2026; the timeline selects major milestones through October 2026. Partnership commitments and future investment plans are not treated as completed achievements.
strings.facts.fact-01.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.fact-02.label: Education
strings.facts.fact-02.value: Bachelor’s in electrical engineering; master’s in computer science, University of Wisconsin–Milwaukee; MBA, University of Chicago
strings.facts.fact-03.label: Associated organizations
strings.facts.fact-03.value: Microsoft; previously worked at Sun Microsystems
strings.highlights.highlight-01.title: Cloud transition
strings.highlights.highlight-01.text: As a cloud-business leader and CEO, helped expand Microsoft into cloud infrastructure and subscription services.
strings.highlights.highlight-02.title: Developer ecosystem
strings.highlights.highlight-02.text: Advanced Microsoft’s announced acquisition of GitHub, strengthening its links with developers and open-source communities.
strings.highlights.highlight-03.title: AI partnership
strings.highlights.highlight-03.text: Expanded the long-term OpenAI partnership in 2023, connecting AI with Azure and Microsoft products.
strings.timeline.event-01.title: Outlines cloud and AI strategy
strings.timeline.event-01.text: Discussed continued investment in cloud platforms, AI infrastructure and Copilot in his annual shareholder letter.
strings.timeline.event-02.title: Expands the OpenAI partnership
strings.timeline.event-02.text: Microsoft announced additional multiyear investment and technical cooperation, extending a relationship begun in 2019.
strings.timeline.event-03.title: Elected Microsoft chairman
strings.timeline.event-03.text: Independent directors unanimously elected him board chair while he continued as CEO.
strings.timeline.event-04.title: Announces the GitHub acquisition
strings.timeline.event-04.text: Explained Microsoft’s proposed purchase of GitHub and its commitment to developers and open platforms.
strings.timeline.event-05.title: Announces the LinkedIn acquisition
strings.timeline.event-05.text: Microsoft announced a roughly $26.2 billion acquisition of LinkedIn, expanding professional networking and enterprise services.
strings.timeline.event-06.title: Becomes Microsoft CEO
strings.timeline.event-06.text: Succeeded Steve Ballmer as Microsoft’s third chief executive.
strings.timeline.event-07.title: Earns an MBA
strings.timeline.event-07.text: Completed the University of Chicago’s master’s program in business administration.
strings.timeline.event-08.title: Joins Microsoft
strings.timeline.event-08.text: Entered Microsoft and later led enterprise software, online services and cloud businesses.
strings.timeline.event-09.title: Completes a computer science master’s
strings.timeline.event-09.text: Earned a master’s degree in computer science at the University of Wisconsin–Milwaukee.
strings.timeline.event-10.title: Born in India
strings.timeline.event-10.text: Born in Hyderabad; later pursued higher education in India and the United States.
